    SELECT m.name, m.first_name, COUNT(a.id) AS absent_days, SUM(a.hours) AS hours, UPPER(m.code) AS code, CHAR(65) AS letter

      AND m.level BETWEEN {$data['level']['min']} AND {$data['level']['max']}
